translations.name: Metro Transit Reduced Fare Programs
translations.description: Metro Transit gives some riders lower fares on MetroBus and MetroLink. This includes people age 65 or older, people with disabilities, and Medicare cardholders. Seniors need a photo ID from the government. Riders who are applying because of a disability must first be approved by Metro ADA Services. Call 314-982-1510 to get started.
translations.website_description: Reduced MetroBus and MetroLink fares for seniors, people with disabilities, and Medicare cardholders
